temperature_target: Each member's logits before softmax, with one shared temperature
fine_temperatures: Offsets of 0.025, 0.05 and 0.075 on each side of the best coarse temperature, excluding coarse duplicates
selection_rule: Select the lowest full-validation CUDA FP32 BPB, then confirm the selected checkpoint on CPU FP32. Do not use test scores for calibration.
